title: Grade 6 Math: Open Problem-Based Course
sourceTitle: Open Up Resources 6–8 Math, Grade 6 (First Edition), authored by Illustrative Mathematics
author: Illustrative Mathematics (published by Open Up Resources)
licenseEvidence: Every Grade 6 student page on access.openupresources.org (redirected from im.openupresources.org) states: 'Materials developed by Open Up Resources are published as Open Educational Resources under Creative Commons license CC BY.' The publisher's 'Open Up Resources 6–8 Math' license page (openupresources.org/open-up-resources-6-8-math-license/, now 404; Wayback snapshot 2020-11-24) says the curriculum content is licensed CC BY 4.0, except assessments, some images (GeoGebra, Spanish-text), and the Open Up Resources / Illustrative Mathematics names, logos and graphic design. Required attribution, on every digital page view: "Download for free at openupresources.org." This plan uses only lesson/activity titles, links, and our own questions; no assessments or images.
description: A full, problem-based sixth-grade math course from an open textbook: area and surface area, ratios, rates and percentages, fraction division, decimals, equations and exponents, negative numbers and the coordinate plane, and statistics. Each day opens with a short warm-up, works through the lesson's activities on the free student page, then finishes with practice problems and the lesson summary.
includes: Link to the free student page and practice problems for every lesson
Warm-up, activities, practice, and summary steps each day
Extra questions with answers for every lesson
